messages.subject: plot results of fund() on mac
parts:
Hello,

I am having a lot of troubles with the function fund(). Using the same .wav file sometimes it delivers an object sometimes it doesn't, it says NULL. I am using extracts that are at least 0.025 seconds long. 

When I manage to get a result (table with x and y values) the plot is all white.

I am running a Mac with Mountain Lion and I have installed the extras needed to run seewave. 

Any help would be very much appreciated.

Thank you very much.



Greta Carrete Vega

Université de Montpellier 2 (MsC)

messages.author: 81439b8bd59af81b
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] plot results of fund() on mac
parts:
Hi Greta,

what window length did you use to run fund()?
The default window length is 512 in fund(), so if your sampling frequency is 44.1kHz, it results in a window length of 11.6ms. As default overlap is set as 0 in fund(), there is only 2.16 windows for the analysis in a 0.025s object. If the fmax you chose for detection is not precise, fund() might be unstable on only 2 points?

Hope this helps.
I guess you might need to send you code and some .wav samples if you need more help.

Clementine
